author: How It Should Have Ended
description:
The Supergirl HISHE Cartoon.  How the movie Supergirl should have ended.  Kara has multiple chances to save Krypto. The Brigands meet a very prepared weapons designer. And Kara proves to Ruthye she can practice what she preaches.  And Lobo is there for some reason.

How It Should Have Ended (HISHE) makes silly alternate endings to your favorite movies.  Let us know what movie you'd like us to select next!
